Melbourne Red Metallic (A75) over Black Dakota Leather w/ Red Highlight (LCL3), 181-horsepower B48B20 inline-4 paired with an 8-speed ZF automatic, assembled in Regensburg, Dingolfing, Germany. Being the base powertrain for Canada, the 320i xDrive Sedan didn't have traditional BMW trim lines, and was considered its own trim. This car is equipped with the Sport Line Package which includes, but is not limited to, a heated sport steering wheel, sport seats, a sunroof, and 18" alloy wheels (which, on this particular car, have been replaced with some heinous wheels from an older 6-Series). Dakota leather upholstery was also compulsory for Sport Line Package cars.
